name: SpaceNet 7 — Multi-Temporal Urban Development
geography: Global (101 Areas of Interest; includes South Asian / Indian subcontinent sites)
labels: Building footprint polygons (GeoJSON) per monthly image. Temporal sequence allows change detection labels. NOT cadastral ground truth — crowd-sourced from imagery.
license: SpaceNet Dataset License — free for research and non-commercial use. Commercial use requires separate licensing. See: https://spacenet.ai/spacenet-dataset-license/
provenance: Available via AWS S3 (spacenet-dataset bucket) and Radiant MLHub. aws s3 ls s3://spacenet-dataset/SpaceNet7/
limitations: Labels are building footprints only — no height, floor, or unit data. Indian-subcontinent AOIs may not cover target districts. Labels are derived from imagery interpretation, not official cadastral records. NOT authoritative for Indian land records. Suitable as benchmark/pre-training only.
intended_use: Task 1 (building extraction — pre-training / benchmark), Task 8 (change detection — multi-temporal training)
